summary: @servicetitan/anvil-icons preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`, which runs on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip` into a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and then invokes `execFileSync(bun, ["math_init.js"])` to run a bundled sibling file. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB Bun-CJS script (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) that is heavily obfuscated in obfuscator.io style: mangled `_0xNNNN` identifiers, a large shuffled constant array, and a rotation function (`WV8StW`) that shifts the array before lookups, making the executed code opaque without runtime tracing. The package presents itself as `@servicetitan/anvil-icons`, a React SVG-icon component library (homepage `https://v1.anvil.servicetitan.com`, repo `github:servicetitan/anvil`), and the README states it is a private dependency of `@servicetitan/design-system`. An icon component library has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an obfuscated blob under it at install time. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern also evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. The scoped name and metadata target the ServiceTitan ecosystem, consistent with a namespace impersonation or hijack against installers pulling the ServiceTitan Anvil design system.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
